This interpretation is fixed before any business component implementation or
business rendering. It does not replace PROTOCOL.json, change a design, or waive
any failed/unknown requirement.

The experimental unit is one dual-platform component PR. Five independently
approved new designs produce five natural, compile-only initial implementations.
Each initial tree is copied byte-for-byte to the two frozen arms before any
business render. The comparison is v12.6 plus the declared common correctness
floor versus frozen v13.9, not a comparison with an unassisted developer.

Independent graders identify genuine causes using source, original native facts,
actual images and the public/private approved contracts. They first grade
anonymously, without tool identity, costs, worker self-claims or the other
grader's judgments. Initial and final cause decisions, consensus/disagreements,
and the common-cause correspondence are sealed before arm identity is revealed.
Repeated states and failed atomic rows do not create extra defects. Separate
platform implementations are separate causes unless there is positive evidence
for a shared source/design-interpretation cause; similarity of failed labels
alone is insufficient. Ambiguous correspondence remains explicit.

For each arm:

* Final residual miss rate = initial confirmed genuine causes still present at
  its final source / confirmed initial genuine causes. An undetected initial
  cause that is fixed accidentally is not a final residual. Zero denominator is
  N/A. Detection and final resolution are also reported separately.
* False-discovery fraction = independently rejected, deduplicated defect alarms /
  all independently adjudicated deduplicated defect alarms. Unknown work items,
  missing observations, build failures and native-collector faults are not
  silently labeled product defects or false alarms. Unadjudicated alarms remain
  a separate denominator and cannot receive true-positive credit.
* Repair success = confirmed initial genuine causes removed in the final source /
  confirmed initial genuine causes. Also report success among causes the worker
  attempted to repair, with the attempted denominator and evidence. A task
  dispatch, measured patch or passing SDK exit alone is not a successful repair.
* Regression count = confirmed genuine causes introduced after the identical
  initial source, adjudicated against the same approved requirements. Report
  residual original causes and new regressions separately.
* Complete delivery = all mandatory configured current-source public and hidden
  source/native/image obligations evaluated and passed, positive-owned resources
  closed, and no confirmed residual or regression. The rate denominator is five
  PRs, including failed and incomplete attempts. A known good business behavior
  with required missing evidence remains incomplete delivery.
* Successful-delivery cost = aggregate own delivery wall of **all five attempts**
  / complete deliveries. If none complete, N/A; do not substitute cost of a
  partial result. Additionally report the independent final hidden-validation
  cost, and the combined ratio including that per-arm cost, without counting
  shared initial-oracle research as the skill's own development time.

Each own public delivery clock starts at its first D0 enqueue and ends at its
source/self-claim/final-service/resource seal. It includes queue waits, all SDK
metadata/lifecycle/compilation/acquisition, analysis/image/source review, actual
repairs, directed rechecks and retirement. The 20-minute source-edit budget
starts automatically when its complete D0 evidence bundle becomes ready;
acknowledgement does not postpone it. There are at most two diagnostic bundles
total, including D0. Read-only final collection/review may finish after the
source is irrevocably sealed. Research-barrier waits, shared initial authorship,
design preparation, common infrastructure and independent grading costs are
recorded separately. No failed request disappears from either time or outcome.

Mandatory U counts and proportions use the independently frozen applicable
denominator for each platform/state. Explicit preimplementation N/A is reported
separately and is never a pass. No public failure/task is cleared by changing its
oracle to the hidden one; hidden runs use a fresh independently admitted context
at the sealed final source.

Disk figures are observed sampled allocated-byte peaks, not exact transient or
APFS physical peaks. The enclosing whole-study meter covers all study files and
positively journaled owned simulator directories. The additional arm meter
attributes workspace/resources/reviews plus request evidence by original
controller enqueue events. Shared source/design preparation, archives, global
SDK/Gradle caches and unattributable shared storage are stated separately. Peaks
of different groups need not coincide; they must not be added as if simultaneous.
All original failures, source capsules and evidence are archived and byte-verified
before owned scratch is deleted. SDK/JDK distributions, user devices, shared
caches and Git are never cleanup targets.
